name: identity_echo_hunter_intelligence
label: The Echo of the Unmade Self
godotFeature: GDScript for dynamic AI states and logic, ShaderMaterial for visual adaptation, AnimationPlayer for behavioral changes
poeticVision: The profound unease of fighting a hunter that embodies your own forgotten strengths and vulnerabilities. Every attack is a painful reminder of what's slipping away, a mirror held up to your own dissolving identity. You don't just fight a monster; you fight a distorted version of yourself, weaponized by the Silence.

parameters.name: player_node_path
parameters.description: Path to the player's CharacterBody3D node in the scene tree.

parameters.name: movement_speed
parameters.description: Base movement speed of the hunter.

parameters.name: pursuit_range
parameters.description: Distance at which the hunter begins pursuing the player.

parameters.name: attack_range
parameters.description: Distance at which the hunter attempts to attack the player.

parameters.name: attack_cooldown
parameters.description: Time in seconds between hunter attacks.

parameters.name: distortion_amount
parameters.description: Shader uniform: Controls the visual distortion effect, adapting based on Lyra's lost memories.

parameters.name: color_shift
parameters.description: Shader uniform: Controls a color shift effect, adapting based on Lyra's lost memories.

verdict: A haunting echo of self, weaponized by the Silence, turning every fight into a desperate, personalized struggle against the very essence of forgetting.
impact: This mechanic transforms the abstract concept of identity loss into a tangible, immediate, and deeply personal combat encounter. Players will not just fight an enemy, but confront the consequences of their own fading self, making every encounter a poignant struggle against internal decay mirrored by external threat. It creates a profound sense of unease and a unique challenge that evolves with the player's narrative state, ensuring constant tension and a deeply integrated theme.
